title: AMTFV: Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification for LLM Self-Correction
abstract: arXiv:2607.29549v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models have demonstrated strong mathematical problem-solving capabilities, yet reliably verifying their candidate answers remains challenging. Existing representative methods mainly revise outputs through natural-language reflection or assist verification by directly generating verification programs; the former may not reliably support exact computation, whereas the latter prematurely couples mathematical modeling with low-level implementation. We propose AMTFV (Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification). By introducing Mathematical Tool Flow (MTF) as an interrupt--execute--resume interface, AMTFV decouples verification modeling from concrete execution and supports exact computation through a mathematical toolbox. translated_title: AMTFV：面向大语言模型自我纠错的智能体数学工具流验证
translated_abstract: 大语言模型已展现出强大的数学问题求解能力，然而如何可靠地验证其候选答案仍具挑战性。现有的代表性方法主要通过自然语言反思来修正输出，或通过直接生成验证程序来辅助验证；前者可能无法可靠地支持精确计算，而后者则过早地将数学建模与底层实现耦合在一起。我们提出了 AMTFV（智能体数学工具流验证）。通过引入数学工具流（MTF）作为“中断—执行—恢复”接口，AMTFV 将验证建模与具体执行解耦，并借助数学工具箱支持精确计算。具体而言，验证智能体首先构建验证工作流，将需要可靠执行的数学对象和计算意图编码为 MTF 请求，并将其发送至（数学工具箱执行）……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出 AMTFV 框架，通过数学工具流（MTF）“中断—执行—恢复”接口将验证建模与具体执行解耦，使大语言模型能够借助数学工具箱进行精确计算，从而实现可靠的答案自我纠错。
en_tdlr: AMTFV introduces a Mathematical Tool Flow (MTF) interrupt-execute-resume interface that decouples verification modeling from concrete execution, enabling LLMs to perform exact computation via a mathematical toolbox for reliable answer self-correction.
